skill: trailofbits/skills plugins/insecure-defaults (a command + workflow plugin; its six reference corpora were applied by hand: report-when / skip-when, then a refuting pass per candidate)

findings.title: TLS verification: the unconfigured state is the secure one
evidence: Vault__API.tls_verify defaults True (L28); Schema__Remote_Config.tls_verify defaults True (L14); resolve_tls_verify returns True on any exception or absent config (L39-48)
the insecure state needs an explicit --no-verify-tls (SE-004 covers its persistence)

findings.title: SG_SEND_PASSPHRASE is read from the environment with no literal fallback
evidence: _prompt_passphrase L57-67: os.environ.get('SG_SEND_PASSPHRASE') else getpass; no default value
CLI__PKI L30, L213 same pattern; keygen refuses an empty passphrase (L31-32)

findings.title: 48-bit truncations: file ids are HMAC-SHA256[:12 hex], object ids sha256[:12 hex] on format 1
evidence: derive_file_id L146-148 returns mac[:12]; compute_object_id L183-190 12 or 32 hex by format
file ids are per-vault and per-domain-string, and a collision is an error, never an overwrite (register)
all primitives otherwise modern: AES-256-GCM, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 600k, HKDF-SHA256, ECDSA P-256/SHA-256, RSA-OAEP-SHA256 4096, os.urandom

findings.title: ~/.sg-send, its pki/ folders and .sg_vault/local are created with the default umask (0755): names visible, contents 0600 where secret
evidence: os.makedirs(home) L21 and PKI__Key_Store L21 with no mode; secret files go through Vault__Secret_File / write_private (0600); public PEMs and metadata.json are written 0644 by plain open() (L25-38), which is correct for public data

findings.title: --debug prints request paths including query strings to stderr; a presigned S3 URL's query carries X-Amz-Credential and X-Amz-Signature
evidence: _format_path L56-68 strips scheme and host, unquotes, and truncates at 67 characters; the query string is kept
Vault__Batch._upload_large L142 logs the presigned PUT url; Vault__API presigned reads log theirs
opt-in (enabled only with --debug); the 67-character cut usually ends before X-Amz-Signature but after the path, so the credential id can appear

proposed.test: unit: a presigned url logs as its path only

findings.title: no seeded or default credential anywhere in the group
evidence: Bandit B105 hits ('token' at CLI__Token_Store L6, 'pass' in Enum__Doctor_Status) are file names and an enum value, not credentials
